generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document.

The intending bidder shall be a registered Income Tax assessee and must possess a valid Permanent Account Number (PAN) issued by the Income Tax Department, Government of India, along with a valid Goods and Services Tax (GST) Registration in accordance with the GST Act. The bidder shall submit self-attested, legible scanned copies of PAN Card and GST Registration Certificate along with the bid. The Bidders should furnish a scanned copy the latest Income Tax returns.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: O&M of 10 MW Solar PV plant at Shivanasamudram, Mandya District for a period of two years and extendable by one more year.

itemList.description: Providing Man Power for O&M of 10MW Shivanasamudram Solar plant at Mandya Dist. as per scope of work in tender document.

Attending petty repair to Solar PV plant and office buildings such as laying of concrete, providing plastering, painting etc., and carpentary works such as repairs to doors, windows & ventilators, roof of building including material cost, transportation, labour cost, T&P etc. replacement of bulbs & eletrical fittings, house keeping materials, Chemicals for weed cleaning ,materials for garden maintenance such as fertilizers, pesticides etc., refilling of fire extinguishers, pest control, maintenance of PC & printer etc.
Miscellaneous works - Procurement of DC cables, AJB spare and Inverters, Transformers, HT breakers, CT, PT , Isolator services by OEM agency and other associated works.
